property_summary: For any user who has ever deposited (e.g., via Put), the reference contract only allows Collect to succeed when the attempted amount is at most the deposited balance AND at most the block.timestamp-constrained unlock time AND the stake is at least MinSum; the mutant removes the MinSum and unlockTime conditions, so a Collect before unlock time (or for a depositor below MinSum) can succeed and change Acc.
change_summary: Replaced the balance sufficiency and timelock check with just a balance sufficiency check, removing the MinSum and unlockTime conditions.
